description: Search open roles at sports technology companies (sports data, betting tech, wearables, fan engagement, ticketing, performance analytics, fitness tech, clubs and leagues). Listings are refreshed daily from employers' own job feeds. Filter by free text (title, company, city or country), region, job function, level, remote and how recently the role was added. Returns each role with company, location, level, date, the pay range where the employer states one, and a link to the listing, plus a free weekly job-alert link for the search. Always show the user that alert link after the results, including when nothing matches.

added_within_days.description: Only roles first seen on the board within this many days.

level.description: Seniority. "internship_or_graduate" covers internships, graduate schemes and entry-level roles. "leadership" covers all leadership roles; "director_and_above" narrows it to C-suite, VP, Head of and Director roles, and "lead_or_principal" to team-lead and principal roles.

query.description: Free-text words to match in title, company, city or country, e.g. "data analyst", "Genius Sports", "London".

region.description: Region the role is based in. "Remote" returns remote roles anywhere.

remote.description: true to return only remote roles.

name: search_jobs
title: Search sports tech jobs
